title: Sony Is Giving You a Reason to Party With $100 Off One of Our Favorite Speakers
gist: A WIRED affiliate deals roundup of Sony ULT party speakers at what it calls their lowest-ever prices, led by the ULT Tower 7 at $548 ($102 off). It also notes that electronics prices are rising across the board.

insights.claim: WIRED says Sony's ULT party speakers are at their lowest prices ever: the ULT Tower 7 is $548 (16% off $650), the ULT Tower 5 $348 (23% off), the ULT Field 7 $448, the ULT Tower Max $1,198 (20% off $1,500) and the ULT Field 1 $108.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Heavy discounting of Sony audio at Amazon and Best Buy ahead of the holidays is a datapoint on retail promotions.

insights.claim: The ULT Tower 7 puts out 420 watts with 30-hour battery life, the ULT Tower 5 300 watts with 20 hours, and the plug-in ULT Tower Max 2,150 watts.
insights.speaker: Les Shu

insights.claim: WIRED notes that electronics prices are increasing across the board, so the ULT Field 1's $108 may be a new low even though it has dipped below $100 before.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: This is anecdotal evidence of consumer-electronics price inflation going into the holiday season.
insights.quote: with electronics increasing in price across the board, this could be new low
insights.locator: When you want something more intimate
